question.problem:
Determine the number of pivot columns of the matrix $C,$ given by

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 8 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
First, we need to convert $C$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 8 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+\frac{1}{2}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 8 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $C$ has $4$ pivots, and therefore the number of pivot columns is $4.$
